711000102.text: Eek! Mao, look out behind you!

711000104.text: Huh? Oh, no, no, she's my friend! Didn't I tell you before that I had a lot of friends? I just happened to meet her, so I "got a hold of her" to introduce to you!

711000106.text: Huh? Oh, no, no, she's my friend! Didn't I tell you before that I had a lot of friends? I just happened to meet her, so I "got a hold of her" to introduce to you!

711000108.text: That's right! I told you before that I had a lot of friends, didn't I? Well, I just happened to meet her, so I "got a hold of her" to introduce to you!

711008801.text: I wonder where she's off adventuring nowadays. I can't wait to receive my next letter from her!

711008802.text: Yeah, this Big Sis of yours sure seems like an interesting person!

711008803.text: I know, right? Still, Big Sis Fujin needs our help, so let's continue on!

711008804.text: Oh, there you all were. Ah, I was so worried...

711008806.text: ... *cough* One was quite concerned that the swirling miasmas and fierce beasts that roam might have caused you ill. But one sees that it is not so, and that is good.

711008807.text: #Thanks to the adeptal energy you possess, {NICKNAME}, one has been connected to the Golden Carp here, thus gaining the means to speak with you directly.

711008808.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, Little Mao, please come with me.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take care of the nearby miasma

711008701.text: However, she hasn't written to me in a long time. If I were to guess, she's off adventuring in some faraway place. Maybe in the "Ancient City of Ys," or something like that.

711008704.text: Heh, this Big Sis of yours sure seems like an interesting person!

711008705.text: I know, right? Still, Big Sis Fujin needs our help, so let's continue on!

711008706.text: Oh, there you all were. Ah, I was so worried...

711008708.text: ... *cough* One was quite concerned that the swirling miasmas and fierce beasts that roam might have caused you ill. But one sees that it is not so, and that is good.

711008709.text: #Thanks to the adeptal energy you possess, {NICKNAME}, one has been connected to the Golden Carp here, thus gaining the means to speak with you directly.

711008710.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, Little Mao, please come with me.

711000701.text: Much time has passed since I last emerged here.

711000702.text: This was once a lively place, filled with the aroma of incense... Then, the three of us could travel freely across the mountains and rivers.

711000703.text: Yes... Those days were like flowing water 'neath the moon, dark, yet sparkling oh so brightly...

711000705.text: Thanks to you all, I am now able to return here and host the Rainjade Rite.

711000706.text: Eh? So... you're that person in the mural?

711000707.text: Oh, I get it now! That person... standing on the mountain, hugging that egg, that was you, wasn't it?

711000708.text: Ah— An egg? Come now, Little Mao, that was precious jade!

711000709.text: "Casting Rainjade" is a ritual of great power. The Votive Rainjade can calm rivers, improve the weather... But it can also be a thing of death and slaughter. Only the thinnest line separates curses and the adeptal energies that have aided you up till now.

711000710.text: That is why I must make sure that the Rite does not fall into the hands of those who would do ill. That's why... Ahem, yes, that is correct, one was indeed the figure who "hugged that egg" in that mural.

711000711.text: Huh... Big Sis Fujin, doesn't this make you pretty, uh, ancient?

711000712.text: Yes, it does. Still, I do like the name "Big Sis." It does quite make me feel young!

711000715.text: Well, certainly! Though even if others title me as such, I am aware that I am hardly the equal of true adepti like Mountain Shaper and the rest.

711000716.text: I am, in truth, the weakest of my band of friends. I cannot make medicines to save others, nor can I bound across the mountains and plains. Even so, I could not simply lay the title down.

711000717.text: It would have done the people of Chenyu Vale a disservice, I fear.

711000718.text: Still, you may call me whatever you wish. After all, we... have become friends, or so I would say.

711000719.text: In any case, my days of being called an adeptus are now consigned to history, just like this place has been.

711000720.text: Once, the Rainjade Rite was a day of great celebration, where we would commemorate the year of abundance, using laughter, firecracker battles, and beast dances to frighten the ill omens away. This must appear like naught but forgotten ruins to the modern mind.

711000722.text: That's right. People in Qiaoying Village told us that it was the mighty Adeptus Fujin who defeated the demons and planted the first tea tree. Back on the bamboo raft, Grandpa Lu also mentioned that the offerings of tea were to a certain Carp adeptus.

711000723.text: And wasn't there that opera sung at Yilong Wharf about the Carp going around killing stuff? Hehe, you were so awesome in those stories, Big Sis Fujin! Also, people still do the Wushou dance, you know!

711000724.text: You said it yourself. The definition of an "adeptus" is...

711000726.text: Also, putting definitions aside, you're our friend, Fujin! You shouldn't be constantly fretting about the rite and stuff. You should live happily — like we're companions on an adventure!

711000727.text: That's right, we're on an adventure together!

711000728.text: Right... Yes, you're right! Thank you — that was well said! Indeed. I was the one who asked you all for help. It wouldn't do at all if I just continued wallowing in the past, now would it?

711000729.text: In any case, I'll need your help to prepare for the Rite itself.

711000730.text: In any case, have you encountered any Sacred Simulacra in your adventures? Those were ritual spirits often used by people in ancient times to protect their homes. There should be some nearby.

711000731.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, Little Mao, please help me put the Simulacra in their proper places. That way, we can restore the spirit veins using the Rainjade Rite.

711000733.text: I will. I have faith in you.

711006701.text: The Sacred Simulacra are all ready!

711006702.text: Thank you both. The Votive Rainjade has been returned to its priests, and the statues have come back to their rightful places. The Rainjade Rite is now ready to be performed.

711006703.text: ...But will Chenyu Vale really recover once you cast the Rainjade in?

711006704.text: That's right. Things will get better for us, Little Mao. Nature, jade, humans... All is divinely dictated. The changes in the land and water in Chenyu Vale, the malicious fog in the spirit veins... They are all essentially a sign of the earth moving against the flow of time.

711006705.text: Yeah. Huh, so that miasma-like thing is a manifestation of environmental disorder...?

711006706.text: Hehe, that's right. You can think of it like Chenyu Vale's attempt to... How to put it? Return to nature? And what we intend to do here is to treat the land and soil, and rid it of this sickness.

711006708.text: After all, before humans left their caves and mountains to dominate the world and regulate nature, and before Chenyu Vale or Bishui River got those names, the land, mountains, and rivers had their own order.

711006709.text: Hehe, even I sometimes miss the cool mountain streams, and the great rivers that would ebb and flow with the seasons. I mean, I was once a mere fish that swam...

711006710.text: But if we let nature seize control of its order once more, the people of Chenyu Vale will suffer and languish. I hope you can understand.

711006717.text: It seems I am too feeble in my current state.

711006718.text: Eh? We got the Votive Rainjade, and we placed the Simulacra, but it still wasn't enough?

711006719.text: I'm very sorry — it is not your fault. I need more power to overcome this trial. Just as the adeptal energy in the Votive Rainjade has dissipated into the spirit veins, so has my power also left me across the long years.

711006720.text: Huh? Will you grow really big just like the jade?

711006722.text: Hehe, just think about it, though — Super Adeptus Fujin, now three times the size! Well, is there any way we can restore your power?

711006724.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, you are wise indeed. Before you found a few Golden Carp, I could not even muster the strength to appear. Initially, I thought that we just needed to gather all the ritual implements, and that would make up for the deficiency in my power...

711006725.text: ...I was not entirely open with you before, but neither the present nor past me was anywhere near a match for the adepti of the south. I... feared you would consider me weak and unworthy of your help...

711006726.text: Gee, is that it? Paimon thought you'd have something more important to say!

711006728.text: There's no way we'd abandon or not make friends with you just because of that!

subQuests.subQuestName: Take care of the nearby miasma

711006801.text: We're here, Big Sis Fujin! Have you been waiting for us here all this time?

711006802.text: #Hehe, no, no. After leaving Carp's Rest, I can only appear in places in which my power remains, and only by the grace of your adeptal energy, {NICKNAME}.

711006803.text: Wait a minute... Didn't the gap in the middle of that mural originally have something that went with the Golden Carp mural in it?

711006804.text: ...I'm not sure. In truth, this is my first time seeing this mural as well.

711006806.text: I'm sure you've all heard of the battles that took place in the past.

711006809.text: Sorry, I am merely a minor adeptus of Chenyu Vale. I fear I know little about any wars concerning this "Khaenri'ah."

711006812.text: Yes. This cave was one of the shelters we built for the inhabitants of Chenyu Vale, such that the innocents caught in the crossfire when the floods overturned the heavens and the earth split open could have a place of safety.

711006813.text: I didn't expect that they'd draw a mural here, though. I believe the ones depicted to be me... *cough* I mean, the "big, slippery Carp" Little Mao mentioned, and a friend.

711006814.text: Huh... If that's the case, why did the most important part get taken somewhere else?

711006816.text: ...Perhaps dissatisfaction. The three of us were once great friends, with two of us becoming worshipped as adepti, and one of us was always the mountain's master.

711006817.text: Later, Herblord and I defected together, and she most likely died too. Or perhaps, the one amongst us who fought to the last never submitted, and only heard news of us afterward.

711006818.text: Perhaps, to her, we were all traitors, with the depictions of myself and Herblord becoming an object for her to vent her fury against.

711006819.text: Huh... Is that really the case? The painting outside looks like...

711006820.text: Who knows? In any case, that's all in the past.

711006821.text: So please, lend me your strength in nursing Chenyu Vale back to health. I can feel that there's another Golden Carp lingering where I used to... Near Mt. Xuanlian, I believe.

711006823.text: If we get that one, I should have enough strength to perform the ritual.

711006824.text: Speaking of that, I must apologize for being unable to control the Golden Carp even with you nearby. I know they might have given you some trouble, swimming through the air like that.

711002701.text: Huh, there's a pavilion here on this mountain!

711002703.text: Huh... Paimon wonders where we'll find that Golden Carp. This place is kinda huge!

711002704.text: #Maybe we can do what we did last time? You know, {NICKNAME}, the bit where you used adeptal energy on the mural, and the Carp turned out to be hiding inside?

711002705.text: #Look, {NICKNAME}! There's four stone Carp statues here! Do you think there might be four giant Carps hiding inside?

711002706.text: #Huh. That does make sense. You're pretty smart, Little Mao! {NICKNAME}, is the adeptal energy reacting in any way?

711002708.text: ...But there seems to be something missing inside.

711002709.text: Huh... That might be where the critical clue lies.

711002710.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, over here! It looks like there's an orb inside some of these Carp statues!

711002711.text: Didn't we find some statues of Carps and large pearl on our way down the mountain? Maybe those are actually used for something!

711002715.text: Well, let's give it a go, then!

subQuests.subQuestName: Use your adeptal energy to activate the Spirit Orb

711004401.text: My apologies for the poor hospitality. It has been a long time since I last enjoyed tea with others. Hopefully, my brewing skills have not deteriorated too much over time.

711004402.text: One d— *ahem* I mean, I have some experience in appreciating tea. It was also thanks to this that I was able to tell that this year's tea offering smelled off. That was how I discovered the trouble with the soil and water quality.

711004405.text: #Hehe, I suppose now I can tell those who fail to appreciate the value of tea about its value with confidence. Come, {NICKNAME}, have some tea!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go back to look for Fujin

711004601.text: Though my power is still a far cry from how it was in the past, thanks to your aid, I have regained much strength. Thank you. Next, we need to perform the ceremony.

711004603.text: It's been thousands of years since we last performed it, and the mountains, rivers, and spirit veins have all changed a great deal. But if all goes well, the Votive Rainjade will resolve the issue.

711004803.text: Huh. It's just like in the mural! Do you remember, Paimon? The one with the two golden people, and something in between them!

711004804.text: Wow, you're really impressive, Little Mao. Paimon didn't remember that at all!

711004806.text: In my era, to merely climb it was already to transgress. But the ancestral inhabitants of this place are gone, and the communing path lies waste and broken. Who shall judge us now?

711004807.text: That is where the spirit veins of Chenyu Vale converge. Through it, I can transmit my adeptal energy throughout the vale, restoring its water and its soil...

711004808.text: #We are only one step off from achieving our goal. Are you prepared, {NICKNAME}?

subQuests.subQuestName: Take care of the nearby miasma

711008501.text: Lingyuan... I perceived it would be you. And I do miss you so, but this really... might be a bad time.

711008502.text: Eh? So Bluey's name is Lingyuan?

711008504.text: Don't be like that. Speak with me.

711008505.text: The opportunity to speak will come, but it is not now. You know this.

711008506.text: I know this, but I cannot allow it.

711008507.text: Wait just a while longer. It will end soon.

711008508.text: I do not like the things up there. But it does not matter. Just leave it to me, Fujin.

711005501.text: I am quite sorry for not being completely frank with you earlier...

711005502.text: Though I became aware of it during our travels, I did not wish to believe that my old friend Lingyuan would be the source of the storm that buffets Chenyu Vale.

711005504.text: Eh? You did? When? How did you figure it out?

711005506.text: She, Herblord, and I once defended Chenyu Vale together. To think that she would do something so wicked... Her disruption of the spirit veins has caused the miasma to propagate, and the one who stopped me from performing the Rite the first time was also her.

711005507.text: But Big Sis Fujin... Bluey... I mean, Lingyuan, isn't a bad person...

711005508.text: ...I know, Little Mao. She is your friend. But at this time, she is the greatest threat to Chenyu Vale. If she controls this sacred mountain, she will wield the power to completely alter the land of Chenyu Vale in the blink of an eye.

711005509.text: I fear that Lingyuan has already entered Chiwang Terrace before us. She means to rewrite the flow and path of the spirit veins... We have little time left.

711005510.text: #{NICKNAME}. You have mastered the adeptal energy available here in Chenyu Vale. Lingyuan and her familiars will not be your match.

711005511.text: Please accompany me for a time and aid me, for the sake of the people in Chenyu Vale. I will perform a ritual and open up the way to Chiwang Terrace. Please stay by my side and... protect me.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take care of the nearby miasma

711005701.text: Why won't you listen to me? Will you not wait?

711005702.text: Your strength is feeble. You cannot match me. But do not worry. You will soon recover.

711005703.text: #Lingyuan... Say no more. {NICKNAME} and I will stop you. We will stop this... plan to destroy Chenyu Vale.

711005704.text: The ritual is complete. The gate to Chiwang Terrace is now open!

711005902.text: Human. Let me tell you what you shall do. Fire arrows at my heart. If you approach up close, strike me with your sword. I will fight you to the last.

711005903.text: You are the only one here who can fight. When I have crushed your neck, I will triumph.

711005905.text: I don't intend to kill you.

711005909.text: ...Fine. You may ask me one question.

711005910.text: You still really care about doing things like that, even though you lost, huh...

711005912.text: Little Mao, do you have any questions?

711005913.text: Um... Bluey... Why did you have to fight? Can't we all be friends?

711005914.text: You bunch of two-legged... And you, Fujin. You have not the strength to form two legs of your own, yet you wish to walk in their form and speak to me. But how can humans and wild beasts ever be friends?

711005915.text: That's not true, Bluey, you're lying! If that's the case, why didn't you just let those beasts eat me back then? If humans and beasts can't be friends, and you're a beast, you shouldn't have helped me!

711005916.text: ...My actions are sometimes beyond even my own understanding. You were merely fortunate.

711005917.text: Well, why didn't you just eat Mountain as well? She almost bumped into you while lost in the fog at the foot of the mountain. I saw it!

711005919.text: You humans possess such wisdom that even nature submits to your will. In that case, you tell me. Why didn't I eat her?

711005920.text: Eh? What kind of question is that...

711005921.text: Mt. Laixin is dear to Adeptus Fujin.

711005922.text: ...Let us just assume you are correct. She has told me much about the Rainjade Rite. Perhaps those memories affected my actions.

711005923.text: You actually remembered everything I told you...

711005924.text: Every year before the rite, you would tell me and that white snake how expectant you were, and how nervous. And after the rite, you would tell us how the festivities were so fun and lively. You would always speak, and I could not help but listen.

711005925.text: Only humans forget. I forget nothing.

711005926.text: You have cleared this doubt of mine. Now, you may ask a question.

711005927.text: Well, Adeptus Fujin, have you any questions?

711005928.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}. Just a while back, Lingyuan, I was telling them stories about our past... Why do you wish to wreck Chenyu Vale, which we once fought so hard to protect?

711005929.text: ...You planted tea trees, promising to enjoy tea with us. This too I remember. But that sort of tea no longer exists.

711005930.text: I want to change this land. I want to make it like it was all those millennia ago. You have walked with humans for too long. You have forgotten that you, I, and the snake all came from nature.

711005931.text: I knew that you never truly perished. And you did not depart this place like the snake. So I wish to change this place to the form it had when you were born. All these years, I have been slowly adjusting the spirit veins.

711005932.text: Oh, I get it! So that's where the miasma came from...

711005933.text: Correct. Side effects. In the end, the process will change the soil, the waters, and the forests to what they should have been.

711005934.text: What the soil, waters, and forest... should have been?

711005935.text: You truly have forgotten the past. The rivers rose and fell with the rains, and their path was not fixed. The tea trees and flowers were not trimmed or cultivated, nor did they exist for humanity.

711005936.text: In such an environment, you would regain your old form, and frolic once more in the great rivers. You would regain your strength. Spiritual power blanketed the land in those days, the wild shrubs grew thick. Now, the mountains and forests are silent, and the shimmering voice of the spring waters, tinkling like jade, can be heard no longer.

711005937.text: But you don't understand. You still think you must stop me.

711005938.text: ...Lingyuan, I count myself more blessed than most to have lived such a happy life, and in the end, my soul returned to my home. You are the one who does not understand.

711005939.text: Yes. And I have never understood. After you defeated me, you should have taken my territory. You planted tea on my mountain and gave that land to the humans. I do not understand why you did this.

711005940.text: Chenyu Vale was once but a nameless land, and we were nameless insects, beasts, and fish. I was the master of an uncultivated mountain, and today, that place belongs to neither of us.

711005941.text: You took a human form and walked among them. You instituted the Rainjade Rite, and helped them change the soil and water. I did not understand then either, but I could see how happy you were.

711005942.text: The snake changed into a human form and used her knowledge to create medicines and save the sick. I could understand how the agile human fingers could help her do what she wished, but I do not know why it was done.

711005943.text: What happened after caused me still more confusion. You fought alongside humans and their so-called gods, and you perished. Humans fighting each other over territory and survival... Now that, I can understand.

711005944.text: You both belong to the great river and the mountainous forests. You could have chosen to leave them and live on with me. Let that which is human belong to them, and nature belong to nature. Even if our territory were to shrink, we could still live freely.

711005945.text: But now you wish to stop me and defend this land subdued by humanity. Answer me. Why?

711005946.text: Lingyuan, my friend... It is as you say. I do wish to protect them.

711005947.text: ...Do not answer me with my own question! I was asking you why.

711005948.text: (This Lingyuan might be a beast, but she sure cares about the order of things, huh?)

711005949.text: (I know! That's how I learned so much from her.)

711005950.text: (...So you guys were just discussing stuff... in the mountains...?)

711005951.text: (Well, not totally. That said, after hearing everything Bluey said about Big Sis Fujin, I thought they'd be happy to meet each other...)

711005952.text: At first, I was like you. I did not understand humanity, and I did not enjoy their... excessive demands and love of hoarding, or their eternal desire to have more than they need, while caring so little for the needy themselves...

711005953.text: "Trading," "wealth"... Like you, I did not understand these concepts and did not understand why they influence human joy and sorrow.

711005954.text: But across the long years, I have also seen many other things.

711005955.text: The cries of children break my heart, and the sound of an old person's shattered memories saddens me... Just as though it were all a microcosm of these mountains and rivers.

711005956.text: Have you noticed them, seen them? The children who wash their little feet in the streams, fishermen laughing beneath the light of the rainbow's arc, the moonlight trysts of lovebirds, their figures painted silver...

711005957.text: Humans, too, are creatures of this land. Just how different is their innocence from ours?

711005958.text: ...You mean to say that you have chosen to take their side due to these emotions. Not through natural principles or logic. And not due to anyone's orders.

711005959.text: I suspect that Herblord had much the same reasons as I. That said, I'm sure she'd put it all very differently, ha!

711005960.text: I remain unsatisfied with your answer, Fujin. I do not understand.

711005961.text: Do you not? I think you've understood for a long time. When our lord... When our previous god raised the waters, it was you who brought your familiars around to attack the people and drive them to the shelters we had created.

711005963.text: ...I just wished to help my friends. To make their wishes reality.

711005964.text: Even if doing so means going against nature and the principles you follow?

711005965.text: Even if it meant going against nature and the principles I follow, I would do so anyway.

711005966.text: Well, then we aren't all that different now, are we? Didn't you also choose your own position on account of your feelings?

711005968.text: I am satisfied with your answer, Fujin. Now, you may ask a question.

711005969.text: #Very well. May I ask the next question, {NICKNAME}, Paimon?

711008603.text: Do you still not understand? She used all the energy she accumulated recently to nurse the land.

711008604.text: Wait, if that's the case... Does that mean...

711008606.text: But... She struggled so hard to...

711008607.text: Though we have now finished nursing the soil and water, the miasma that remains will not disappear immediately, so you'll have to be careful out there.

711008609.text: Sorry for making you all see me like this. It is just as Lingyuan said. I have completely used up the energy I accumulated recently, and I can no longer maintain my favored form.

711008610.text: Waaaaa... Paimon thought... Paimon thought that...

711008612.text: ...*sigh* Nothing, nothing! Paimon's glad you're still here, Adeptus Fujin! Seriously, Lingyuan...

711008616.text: Though my form is as it has become, I am far more comfortable than before. At first, I was trapped at Carp's Rest, and could only reminisce about the outside world through the scent of the tea offerings.

711008617.text: If I had not met you and Paimon, people of such compatibility with the spirit veins, I would have had none but my shadow to talk to, much less be able to leave Carp's Rest.

711008618.text: Thank you for your concern. Please forgive me, but I must depart now. I'll need a bit of rest.

711008620.text: Speak. What else would you have me do? Or not do.

711008621.text: Nothing. I just didn't get to say this due to the circumstances that prevailed before, but...

711008622.text: ...But it's so good to see you again.

711008626.text: Eh? Where did that one come from...

711008627.text: I should thank you for bringing her back. Safe, smooth, and slippery. Even the way in which her fins move is the same as I remember.

711008628.text: You sure have a, uh, strange way of remembering people... or fish, whichever.

711008629.text: I do not know how you did it, nor why you were able to obtain her adeptal energy. All these thousands of years, and I never once heard her voice.

711008630.text: #It might be due to {NICKNAME}'s, uh, unique constitution?

711008631.text: I see. However, I am but a foolish beast. Even if I wanted to see her again, I would not know of a better way.

711008632.text: I could only spend thousands of years clumsily imitating her methods, regulating the spirit veins in this land.

711008633.text: I am quite stupid, and I only knew this method, and so I did it — it was akin to scooping every droplet from a rushing river, or every grain of sand from the vast desert.

711008634.text: I knew as well that she would not smile as she once did, even if these mountains returned to how they once were.

711008635.text: She, I, and the snake once laughed and swam happily here. Those days will never come again.

711008636.text: She loves humanity too much, even more than she loves herself. Had I succeeded, she would only hate me.

711008637.text: But that would have not mattered to me, so long as she could regain her form and swim free once more.

711008638.text: *sigh* And Paimon thought you were more concerned about nature...

711008639.text: Of course I care. A land untamed by humans, a land of wild beasts. But that is a different subject from the matter of Fujin.

711008640.text: If she thinks that a land tamed by humans is better, and that the strange tea leaves grown on such land taste superior, then I shall do what pleases her.

711008643.text: Well, speaking of that, Paimon's curious. What did the tea leaves taste like in the past?

711008644.text: When the land changed before, the tea leaves' flavor was much closer to what it was in the past, apart from some differences due to human influence.

711008645.text: Wait, so you mean that the weirdly flavored teacakes we had were...

711008646.text: In that case, I prefer the current flavor profile...

711008647.text: Tea leaves cultivated by humanity will be more to their liking, of course. What I do not understand is Fujin's tastes.

711008648.text: If the snake was here, we could ask for her opinion. But perhaps her tastes have also become strange from spending so much time with humans.

711008649.text: #Before you go, {NICKNAME}, I have one final question for you.

711008650.text: Those that come from nature will, for some reason, go against nature — against the laws nature originally followed.

711008651.text: Will humans also go against humanity, against the principles they initially followed, for certain reasons?

subQuests.subQuestName: Escort Little Mao back to Qiaoying Village

711006001.text: You're back! We were just saying that good rainfall's bound to bring good tidings! And what do you know, dear guests? You've arrived, right on time!

711006002.text: How did it go? Well, I trust? Tell us all about it!

711006005.text: #So you met the legendary Carp Adeptus!? Oh my, as one would expect of the {M#young master}{F#young miss} of the Feiyun Commerce Guild. You really do have friends in high places!

711000401.text: #You're awesome, {NICKNAME}! You pushed the moss back just like that — like you did with that smoky cloud!

711000402.text: Still, that wasn't there yesterday. Is this what they call "nature"...

711000403.text: #Don't worry about it. Moss or hilichurls, just leave 'em all to {NICKNAME}! Little Mao, what's this picture about?

711000404.text: Hehehe! Originally, I didn't know either, but I figured it out today after hearing Big Sis Fujin's story! This must be the stuff that happened before the mural on Mt. Lingmeng was made!

711000405.text: See this? Long, long ago, people were able to talk to the gods and adepti in the skies by talking to that big piece of jade in the middle.

711000406.text: The emissary of the gods would lead them and protect them. See, that's gotta be this shiny golden person standing in the middle — I bet that was a super amazing person.

711000407.text: But later, just like Big Sis Fujin said, something changed, and the people of Chenyu Vale lost their guiding emissary, and they couldn't talk to the heavens any longer — that's how the Rainjade Rite came about.

711000408.text: Huh. Your story does make sense!

711000414.text: Come to think of it, our ancestors were pretty amazing themselves, huh? The jades they left to us still have the power to restore nature! For something this old to still be so strong, the past must've been a sweller time than the present, huh?

711008901.text: You're back! We were just saying that good rainfall's bound to bring good tidings! And what do you know, dear guests? You've arrived, right on time!

711008902.text: How did it go? Well, I trust? Tell us all about it!

711008905.text: You explain what happened to Grandpa Lu and Uncle Luo...

711008906.text: #So you met the legendary Carp Adeptus!? Oh my, as one would expect of the {M#young master}{F#young miss} of the Feiyun Commerce Guild. You really do have friends in high places!

711009001.text: The Sacred Simulacra... During the earliest festivals, people didn't know how they should carve the statues, and the products turned out a real mess. Even that friend of mine couldn't help but burst into laughter upon seeing it...

711009002.text: #Ah... Sorry about that, {NICKNAME}, I got lost in the past again...

711009901.text: Huh? Why did Little Mao disappear while we weren't looking?

711009902.text: Did he run up ahead of us? There's lots of monsters around here. Let's go up ahead and look.

711009910.text: Well, that's Mt. Xuanlian right up ahead!

711009911.text: Nice. Let's see what clues we can find.

711009916.text: Huh? Fujin? Wait, why'd you turn into a Golden Carp again?

711009917.text: Well, this form makes movement easier. Do you not like it, Paimon?

711009918.text: Well, no. Paimon's just not used to talking to a fish.

711009926.text: The world seems to spin for a moment, and when you open your eyes once more, you are already above the clouds...
